messages:
deploy-bot: kickoff: staged rollout for inference-api v2.3.1 -> start 5% global traffic now :rocket:
prasad: ack. watching p50/p95, 5xx, and cpu on gpu-pool-3
maya: observability dashboard: https://dash.rewood.internal/d/inf?var=service=inference-api - p95 baseline 380ms
taylor: reminder: kv-cache warmup abnormality caused previous spike. I'll tail logs for cache misses.
oncall-sre: set call window: +20m for a stop/go check. If 5xx > 0.8% or p95 > 800ms we hold.
juan: pin v2.3.0->v2.3.1 mapping note: routing rule rn-187 applied, can revert with `routing rollback rn-187`
deploy-bot: rollout update: 5% -> 25% at 1724689075, no widespread errors so far :white_check_mark:
maya: small spike in eu-west: 5xx up 0.6% -> 1.4% over 4m, p95 eu-west 910ms :eyes:
prasad: digging into logs, looks like model shard timeout on host gpu-12, OOM errors in kube events.
taylor: command to check pods: `kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-12`
juan: suggest region pin: route eu-west back to v2.3.0 while we investigate.
deploy-bot: action: pin eu-west -> v2.3.0, initiating routing switch now.
oncall-sre: stop further percentage increases. Hold at 25% global, rollback region eu-west confirmed.
maya: metrics dropping after pin, p95 eu-west -> 420ms, 5xx back to 0.3%
prasad: logs show a heap growth pattern on v2.3.1 on older driver. Will open bug and attach heap dump.
taylor: re: rollout plan — propose resuming at 10% in 30m only after driver fix or node recycle.
oncall-sre: agreed. tagging for postmortem if we see recurrence.
juan: noted for release notes: "rolled v2.3.1 to 25% then pinned eu-west due to OOM on older drivers; investigation ongoing."
deploy-bot: deploy summary: started 5% -> 25%, region eu-west pinned back to v2.3.0, hold on further increases. Next check +30m. :vertical_traffic_light:
